E_md_gpa.basis: compressive initial modulus interpolated at 85 kg/m³ between Chen et al. 2023 (80 kg/m³: 2.77 MPa; 95 kg/m³: 4.27 MPa); used as the bending modulus [E]

crease_length_scale_t.basis: a scored foam hinge is a half-depth cut; L* ≈ 50 t by analogy with scored board [E]

crease_yield_deg.basis: foam is elastic: a cold fold springs back almost fully; a large elastic range stands in for that until heat-forming is modelled [E]

tear_strain.basis: elongation at break > 130 % on an 85–90 kg/m³ EVA datasheet (supplier, via search) [E]

crease_set_rate.basis: cold-folded EVA keeps almost no set [E]

score_factor.basis: a half-depth score leaves t/2: bending ∝ t³ → (1/2)³ [E]

fabrication.score: score with a half-depth knife cut, or heat-form (the engine does not model heat-forming yet)

provenance.author: Innovaciones MADFAM
